CFML Language Reference: Functions

Log

Returns the natural logarithm (base e) of a positive number.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Log(number)

Parameters

number
A number greater than zero.

Returns

A number.

Usage

Zero or a negative number raises an Expression error. Log is the inverse of Exp. For a logarithm in any base b, use Log(x) / Log(b); base 10 has its own function, Log10.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>Log(number)</TH><TH>log base 2</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="1,2,2.71828182846,10,1024">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD>#Log(n)#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Round(Log(n) / Log(2) * 1000) / 1000#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
